summary: Audit split snapshots against legacy state and Electrs
details: Extend compare-legacy with direct immutable core and registry SQLite inputs, reusing the existing bounded shard scanner and frozen semantic difference rules.
Validate paired artifact manifests, schemas, database anchors and scanned row counts; optionally recompute current artifact file hashes before auditing.
Read paired core and registry inputs in Electrs sampling and fail on a missing registry mapping instead of silently replacing the positive-balance sample.
Bind Electrs checkpoint identity to both artifacts and hash verification mode, and provide a plan-only command for offline input and sample inspection.
operator_actions: Use --core-snapshot-db and --script-registry-db for direct legacy-to-split comparison; the original RocksDB comparison remains available for fully replayed sources.
Pass --script-registry-db alongside the core --snapshot-db for Electrs auditing. Reports and checkpoints use v2; create fresh reports instead of reusing v1 checkpoints.
Use --verify-file-hash when this audit must independently bind current file bytes to the manifests; otherwise reports explicitly retain an unverified-hash status.
